newsitem.title: USA: N.J. director of investments to resign next June.
newsitem.headline: N.J. director of investments to resign next June.

text.p: Roland Machold, New Jersey's director of investments, plans to resign his post in June 1998, sources familiar with the move said Thursday.
Machold, who was traveling and could not be reached for comment, is the top manager of New Jersey's multibillion-dollar investment and pension fund systems.

His success in garnering returns well above market rates during the past several years is at the heart of New Jersey's plan next week to sell $2.75 billion of pension system bonds through Merrill Lynch & Co.
The plan counts on Machold's Division of Investments, part of the state Treasury, to earn strong returns for decades in order to pay off the taxable bond issue.
Treasury officials declined to comment on the resignation.
Merrill said earlier this week it planned to price the bonds next Wednesday, with a retail order period beginning Monday.
